q1_issues.issue: "the (U.S.) occupation" is fused into the opaque compound us_occupation, so the U.S. -- a proper noun the text mentions -- gets no symbol and no Name atom, and who is occupying is unrecoverable.

(PartOf abu_qasim sk_group_1) asserts the speaker's membership in the "we" group; the no-antecedent pronoun rule only licenses minting the anonymous group witness, not linking the reported speaker into it.

q2_gaps: direct quotation with quotative inversion ("," said X) -- the attitude section specifies only a finite that-clause complement, so sealing the quoted material under say's Theme is an extension
first- and second-person pronouns inside reported speech ("we") -- the anonymous-witness table covers only he/she/it/they, and nothing says whether the reported speaker resolves them

a proper noun used attributively before a common noun naming a different referent ("Hit resident", "U.S. occupation") -- the naming rules cover a name plus an adjacent kind noun for the same referent only
notes: The connective-endpoint reification of "Saddam is gone" (state witness + flat copular + (But ...) in surface order) and the control treatment of "want the occupation to end" (top-level tenseless end event, occupation as Patient) both follow the instruction set exactly. (LocatedIn abu_qasim hit) renders "Hit resident" as static containment, which loses the residency relation but is a reasonable choice for an unaddressed construction.
